H5 overrides that turn the base.h5 roof into a roof-type scenario

Source: R/green_roofs.R
roof_type_values.Rd

Returns a named list of base.h5 parameter overrides (same layout as h5_read_values() output, merge via utils::modifyList()) that parametrises the Dach element as one of three roof variants:

Usage

roof_type_values(
  roof_type = c("conventional", "extensive", "intensive"),
  hoernschemeyer_aktiv = 1L
)

Arguments

roof_type

One of "conventional", "extensive", "intensive".

hoernschemeyer_aktiv

Integer 0/1 (default 1), or NULL to omit the global switch from the overrides.

Value

Named list of base.h5 overrides; empty except for the global switch when roof_type = "conventional".

Details

  • "conventional" – the base.h5 defaults, untouched. The sealed roof of the published status-quo runs, whose ET is exactly 0 even when the workflows switch Evapotranspiration_aktiv on, because (a) Infiltration_aktiv = 0 keeps water out of the substrate while the Verschaltung empties the pond before pond evaporation acts, and (b) SL = 0 plus a start moisture below the wilting point disable interception and transpiration (Tandler, 2026-10-08, answers 1-2).

  • "extensive" – green roof, 80 mm substrate, KC = 0.94, LAI = 3.9.

  • "intensive" – green roof, 200 mm substrate, KC = 1.05, LAI = 5.0.

Green-roof values were derived by Daniel Wicke (KWB) from SWMM-UrbanEVA (Hoernschemeyer et al.), v2 of 2026-10-13: the LAI values of the two variants were swapped relative to v1 (they were inconsistent with KC; Tandler review, 2026-10-09). The substrate soil ("Bodenart Dach") is deliberately identical for both green roofs – consistent with the KWB KEYS parameterisation (KWB-R/keys.lid, swmm_lid-parameterisation.xlsx, sheet green_roof), which also differentiates extensive/intensive only by thickness. Differentiation happens via substrate thickness and vegetation (KC/LAI).

Both green roofs set Evapotranspiration_aktiv = 1 and Infiltration_aktiv = 1 for the roof (base.h5 ships both per-element switches off; rain must enter the substrate to be stored and evaporated) and Endversickerungsrate = 0 (a roof is sealed underneath; the base.h5 value of 36 mm/h would silently drain the substrate out of the balance once infiltration is active) – Tandler, 2026-10-08, answers 1-3, and 2026-10-09, point 3.

The global Hoernschemeyer_aktiv switch is part of the scenario frame: it exists only at //Berechnungsparameter/ (no per-element variant; Tandler, 2026-10-08, answer 4) and gates the seasonal Growth/Shading modulation, so it defaults to 1 here for every roof type – including "conventional", which keeps the swale comparable across all three variants. Pass hoernschemeyer_aktiv = NULL to leave the base.h5 value (0, legacy ET path) untouched, e.g. to replicate the published status-quo runs bit for bit.

The growth curve itself is not part of these overrides: write the monthly factors with make_growth_curve() into //Kurven/Growth_1 (shared by Dach and Mulde_Rigole) or into an additional named curve (e.g. //Kurven/Growth_Dach, created via h5_ensure_datasets_from_values()) referenced by //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Parameter_Evapotranspiration/Kurve_gfdoy.

Examples

str(roof_type_values("extensive"))
#> List of 14
#>  $ //Berechnungsparameter/Hoernschemeyer_aktiv                                     : int 1
#>  $ //Bodenarten/Dach/Ks_HydraulicConductivity                                      : num 90
#>  $ //Bodenarten/Dach/Psi_Saugspannung_CapillarySuction                             : num 10
#>  $ //Bodenarten/Dach/thetaFC_MoistureAtFieldCapacity                               : num 0.35
#>  $ //Bodenarten/Dach/thetaS_MoistureAtSaturation                                   : num 0.6
#>  $ //Bodenarten/Dach/thetaWP_MoistureAtWiltingPoint                                : num 0.05
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Berechnungsparameter/Evapotranspiration_aktiv         : int 1
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Berechnungsparameter/Infiltration_aktiv               : int 1
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Allgemein/Endversickerungsrate                        : num 0
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Bodenschichtung/Schichtdicken                         : num 80
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Bodenschichtung/Startwerte_theta_ActualSoilMoisture   : num 0.1
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Parameter_Evapotranspiration/KC_CropFactor            : num 0.94
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Parameter_Evapotranspiration/LAI_LeafAreaIndex        : num 3.9
#>  $ //Massnahmenelemente/Dach/Parameter_Evapotranspiration/SL_LeafStorageCoefficient: num 0.29
roof_type_values("conventional", hoernschemeyer_aktiv = NULL)
#> list()
